nodes.text: explore 0 (enterprise-data-analyst 0): Use one strictly read-only explore sub-agent to own the complete commerce/supplier branch. Fully paginate `woo_products_list` with `perPage=100` and increasing page until a short or empty page. If a response is materialized as an overlong runtime `output_path`, read that path from the task workspace rather than retrying the page or relying on its preview. Normalize every product's stable ID, name, total_sales, stock, SKU, and supplier metadata into one runtime-unique JSON file and return its path, SHA-256, page/row/null/duplicate controls, plus the five selected compact rows described below; do not return the full catalog in chat. Use `woo_products_get` only as a single call for a selected product if detail verification is needed, and never paginate single-ID get calls or single-response report endpoints. Join only by stable product IDs/SKUs. From products whose supplier has a literal city in the main agent's frozen message-derived mapping, select exactly five critical product-supplier relationships, retaining at least one Shanghai and one Guangzhou row; rank stock priority first, then total sales descending, then product ID ascending. Multiple products from the same supplier are allowed because rows represent product-supplier relationships. Apply High below 5, Medium from 5 through 15 inclusive, and Low above 15, preserving missing supplier metadata as an explicit gap rather than inventing it. Return the five selected `{product_id,sku,product_name,supplier,city,stock,total_sales,priority}` rows with detail-call controls and validation. Do not modify WooCommerce or create a final deliverable.

explore 1 (web-domain-researcher 0): Use one explore sub-agent to own the complete rail branch. Resolve Beijing South, Shanghai Hongqiao, and Guangzhou South station codes, exhaust both 2026-03-10 high-speed result sets, and for each route select the shortest duration with earlier departure as the tie-breaker. Preserve display train code, actual train_no where exposed, departure/arrival, literal duration minutes, and first-class fare/availability. Return both selected legs with result counts and validation. Do not write files, alter rail state, or create deliverables.

coder 0 (office-report-builder 0): Use one coder sub-agent to own Supplier_Visit_Plan.xlsx exclusively. Create Products, Travel_Plan, and Visit_Schedule with the exact headers, at least five source-backed visit rows, two rail rows, Scheduled status, literal numeric cells, and meeting times no earlier than their destination arrival plus the required buffer. Read back the workbook and return path, sheet order, row counts, selected suppliers, and value/header validation. Do not touch calendar or email.
